pairs.subject: data-access
pairs.evidence: uat/driver/ledger.cjs:55 The shared result reader silently drops unreadable per-character records, allowing ledger coverage and metric comparisons to undercount without identifying the missing evidence.

techniques.evidence: uat/driver/recertify.cjs:35 Findings use a fixed filesystem reader; no family of interchangeable storage implementations was found.
uat/driver/ledger.cjs:27 The inspected ledger has one filesystem implementation, without a second storage driver to compare.
uat/driver/recertify.cjs:29 The inspected access paths parse JSON files rather than construct executable storage queries.
tools/uat-recertify-test.cjs:326 A fault drill exercises the production writeBack path on an isolated filesystem copy and verifies that a torn write preserves the original record.

uat/driver/ledger.cjs:55 resultsOf suppresses decode failures without returning an error, skipped-file identity or incomplete-collection indicator; findings.json has separate reporting, but these per-character files do not.
